# coval_scheduled_run (Resource)

Manages a recurring Coval scheduled run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coval_scheduled_run" "nightly" {
  display_name        = "Nightly Regression"
  run_template_id     = coval_run_template.regression.id
  schedule_expression = "cron(0 2 ? * * *)"
  schedule_timezone   = "UTC"

  # Keep a new schedule disabled until its configuration has been reviewed.
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable schedule name.
- `run_template_id` (String) Run-template ID executed by this schedule.
- `schedule_expression` (String) Rate or cron schedule expression, such as rate(1 day) or cron(0 9 ? * MON-FRI *).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is active.
- `schedule_timezone` (String) IANA timezone used by cron expressions.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that owns this resource. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned scheduled-run ID.
- `last_run_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest produced run when available.
- `last_run_id` (String) ID of the latest produced run when available.
- `name` (String) Canonical API resource name.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = coval_scheduled_run.nightly
  identity = {
    id = "xyz789uvw456rst123abcd"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

#### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String)

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coval_scheduled_run.nightly xyz789uvw456rst123abcd
```
